title: Renaming a rep updates every customer, and a switched-off rep stays
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} shows "Sales Representative - Service Labor" {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Service Parts" {Sales-rep-B}; customer {Customer-B} has {Sales-rep-B} as its one sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet and {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Other.
  • Starting screen: Settings > Staff is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Change {Sales-rep-B}'s last name (for example to "Brook") and save.
  2. Open {Customer-A}'s page.
  3. Open {Customer-B}'s page.
  4. Turn {Sales-rep-A}'s "Sales Representative" switch off (keep the account active) and save.
  5. Open {Customer-A}'s page again.
  6. Open Edit Customer and click the "Sales Representative - Service Labor" field.
  7. Close the dropdown without picking anything and save the customer.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the staff record saves.
  • Step 2: Service Parts shows {Sales-rep-B}'s new name.
  • Step 3: "Sales Representative" also shows {Sales-rep-B}'s new name.
  • Step 4: the staff record saves.
  • Step 5: Service Labor still shows {Sales-rep-A}, now reading "{Sales-rep-A} (Inactive)".
  • Step 6: the field reads "{Sales-rep-A} (Inactive)"; {Sales-rep-A} is not offered in the dropdown and no option is checked.
  • Step 7: the customer saves with no error message, and its page still shows Service Labor "{Sales-rep-A} (Inactive)" and Service Parts with {Sales-rep-B}'s new name.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R22: “Renaming a staff member updates their name in every customer field they hold.”
  • S4-N2: “Turning off a staff member's Sales Representative switch, without deactivating their account, leaves them in the customer fields they hold, as today. In Edit Customer and on the customer page their name reads followed by "(Inactive)", for example "Elliot Brennan (Inactive)", as on the work order (S1-E2). They are not offered in the dropdown, so no option is checked while they hold the field.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 14: “14. (b) "Name (Inactive)", as on a work order. Yes, no option is ticked while they hold the field.”

From: Tech plan "Splitting Sales Representatives — Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 14 Oct 2026, planned against PRD version 8; uploaded 19 Oct 2026 and again, byte-identical, 22 Oct 2026), read in full 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan, what the code does today (section 1): “Assumed but not true today: a rename updates every customer (it updates one, `findOneBy`)”
  • Tech plan, Phase 2 functional tests (section 3.7, rename): “Rename the user, then the view shows the new name on every customer holding them (S4-R22).”
  • Tech plan, Phase 2 functional tests (section 3.7, already held): “An already-held unflagged id saves (S4-N2).”
